title: Novel 3-Amino-2-methylquinazolinone NF-kappaB Inhibitors: Synthesis and Potential Anti-Inflammatory Function.
authors: Mikra, Chrysoula; Petriki, Vasiliki; Tsioupros, Evangelos; Kougioumtzian, Eleni; Michail, Konstantinos; Manta, Stella; Campbell, Barry J; Fylaktakidou, Konstantina C; Papoutsopoulou, Stamatia
one_liner_zh: 该文合成喹唑啉酮类NF-kappaB抑制剂并通过分子对接初步探讨其与p65/DNA复合物的相互作用，但核心是药物化学合成与细胞实验，蛋白-DNA互作建模仅作为辅助验证，深度不足。
abstract: The canonical NF-kappaB pathway is a major regulator of inflammatory responses, and its persistent activation has been linked to chronic inflammatory diseases and cancer development. It is therefore important to develop effective NF-kappaB inhibitors that can potentially be utilized in further preclinical studies. In this study, we have synthesized various quinazolinone compounds using novel methodologies. We specifically utilized a two-step protocol comparing an established protocol to a modified alternative procedure and then successfully established a novel one-pot multi-component reaction. All quinazolinones were tested based on their capacity to inhibit tumor necrosis factor-induced NF-kappaB activation using a commercial transgenic HeLa reporter cell-line. Among the eighteen molecules tested, two compounds affected the NF-kappaB-dependent luciferase activity, the 5o (3-amino-6-hydroxy-2-methylquinazolin-4(3H)-one) and 10 (N-(6-bromo-2-methyl-4-oxoquinazolin-3(4H)-yl)-4-nitrobenzamide). Only the 5o though, bearing OH at R(1) (6 position), attenuated the production of pro-inflammatory interleukin 6 in lipopolysaccharide-stimulated human primary macrophage cultures. Molecular docking analysis provides supportive computational evidence that 5o could interact with the p65/DNA complex and therefore could potentially be developed for further studies that aim to inhibit the canonical NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 经典NF-kappaB通路是炎症反应的主要调节者，其持续激活与慢性炎症性疾病及癌症发展相关联。因此，开发有效的NF-kappaB抑制剂，并可能用于进一步的临床前研究，显得尤为重要。在本研究中，我们采用新方法合成了多种喹唑啉酮化合物。具体而言，我们利用一个两步方案，将既定方案与改良的替代程序进行比较，并成功建立了一种新颖的一锅多组分反应。所有喹唑啉酮均通过商业转基因HeLa报告细胞系，基于其抑制肿瘤坏死因子诱导的NF-kappaB激活的能力进行测试。在测试的十八种分子中，有两种化合物影响了NF-kappaB依赖的荧光素酶活性，即5o（3-氨基-6-羟基-2-甲基喹唑啉-4(3H)-酮）和10（N-(6-溴-2-甲基-4-氧代喹唑啉-3(4H)-基)-4-硝基苯甲酰胺）。然而，仅5o（在R(1)位（6位）带有OH基团）在脂多糖刺激的人原代巨噬细胞培养中减弱了促炎性白细胞介素6的产生。分子对接分析提供了支持性计算证据，表明5o可能与p65/DNA复合物相互作用，因此有望进一步开发用于旨在抑制经典NF-kappaB通路的研究。
